critical_code_review_comments: Web data injection into USER MESSAGE (not system prompt) is production-grade - forces LLM to respond to web context
should_search() uses SKIP_PATTERNS, FORCE_SEARCH_PATTERNS, and SOFT_PATTERNS correctly
Globe icon properly conditionally renders only when msg.web_searched is true
CLARIFICATION_INSTRUCTION rule 5 instructs agents they have live web browsing capability
seed_data_creation: Multiple test chats created during web search testing
